command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0077/probe.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: The four 0.48.0 rows: both directions at disp8 and disp32, six instructions per displacement width. Every instruction sets both REX extension bits (REX = 43): the base and the index are in %r8-%r15 while the register stays in %ax-%di, so ModRM.reg is three bits at [27,3]. The window extremes are %r8/%r9 (low three bits 0/1) and %r15/%r15 with the x8 scale (SIB = ff), and the %r12/%r12 pairs exercise SIB.base = 100 and SIB.index = 100 behind REX.B/REX.X (SIB = 24). The disp8 rows are six bytes (66 43 8b 44 08 08, 66 43 8b 7c ff 08, 66 43 8b 44 24 08 and their 89-direction counterparts) and the disp32 rows are nine, with the signed disp32 at [40,32]. input_sha256 is probe.asm; output_sha256 is the 90-byte .text.
